name: Projects list
why: How work gets into a project, how you find a waiting thread, and when an idle project is archived
ideal: Every running task lives in a project, a waiting thread is two clicks away, and an idle project is archived.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

steps.name: Continue
steps.rule: Continue a cloud session that does project work in its project, instead of leaving it loose.

steps.name: Open
steps.rule: Open the project and read Waiting on you first.

steps.name: Archive
steps.rule: Archive a project idle for 30 days: that stops its threads, and its scheduled tasks do not run.
